hotel.name: The Shore Club Turks and Caicos

verified_facts.text: The Shore Club is at 13 Sea Breeze Close on Long Bay Beach, Providenciales, Turks and Caicos.
verified_facts.excerpt: 13 Sea Breeze Close, Long Bay Beach, Providenciales, Turks & Caicos, BWI

verified_facts.text: Long Bay Beach is the quieter counterpoint to Grace Bay on the opposite side of Providenciales.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Shore Club sits on Long Bay Beach, the quieter counterpoint to the buzzy stretch of Grace Bay on the opposite side of Providenciales.

verified_facts.text: The water at Long Bay is strikingly clear and remarkably shallow, so you can walk far out toward the buoys.
verified_facts.excerpt: The water here is strikingly clear and remarkably shallow—you can walk incredibly far toward the buoys without it rising much above your hips

verified_facts.text: The pools are spaced out by lush tropical greenery and beach loungers are spread far apart.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pools are spaced out by lush tropical greenery, and beach loungers are spread far enough apart that you never feel crowded.

verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in 2017, a little over 10 years after its sister property The Palms on Grace Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel opened in 2017, a little over 10 years after its sister property The Palms started welcoming guests on the opposite side of the island along Grace Bay.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations range from Garden, Pool and Ocean View suites to one- to three-bedroom residences and a handful of penthouses, plus private villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Accommodations range from Garden, Pool, and Ocean View suites to sprawling one- to three-bedroom residences and a handful of penthouses.

verified_facts.text: The oceanfront one-bedroom suite has a generous kitchen, airy living room, a spa-like bathroom with a tiled shower and big soaking tub, and a king bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: with a generous kitchen, airy living room with a television, spa-like bathroom with a tiled shower and a big soaking tub, and plush king bed

verified_facts.text: Beyond the Dune Spa there is a lap pool and gym beside the yoga pavilion, and tennis courts that can be reserved for tennis and pickleball.
verified_facts.excerpt: beyond the Dune Spa, there’s a lap pool and gym tucked beside the yoga pavilion, as well as tennis courts that can be reserved for both tennis and pickleball

verified_facts.text: At the Dune Spa, massages and other treatments take place in little huts reached by a hidden walkway surrounded by greenery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Massages and other treatments take place in little huts, which your technician will guide you to.

verified_facts.text: The Dune Spa's facilities are small.
verified_facts.excerpt: The facilities at The Dune Spa are small but mighty, providing great services without many bells or whistles.

verified_facts.text: Sui-Ren is the hotel's signature restaurant, serving Japanese cuisine with Peruvian influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sui-Ren is the hotel’s signature high-end restaurant, focusing on Japanese cuisine with Peruvian influences.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served at Almond Tree, an indoor-outdoor space that also serves dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breakfast is served at Almond Tree, an indoor-outdoor space that also operates for dinner.

verified_facts.text: Guests get complimentary non-motorized water sports equipment such as snorkels, sea kayaks, paddle boards and Hobie Cats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Shore Club offers guests complimentary non-motorized water sports equipment, like snorkels, sea kayaks, paddle boards, and hobie cats.

verified_facts.text: The complimentary Jungle Jam kids' club offers half and full days of activities for ages 4 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: The complimentary Jungle Jam kids' club draws a lot of families, as it provides half and full days of activities for younger guests ages 4–12.

verified_facts.text: Taxis are the main way to get around and they are not cheap.
verified_facts.excerpt: Otherwise, your best bet is to call a taxi to get around, though they don’t run cheap.

verified_facts.text: Accessible pathways cover many shared spaces, including restaurants, pools and beachfront areas, with elevator access in multi-level buildings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests will find accessible pathways across many of the resort’s shared spaces, including restaurants, pools, and beachfront areas, and elevator access in multi-level buildings.

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler named the resort to its Hot List in 2017.
